name: Product launch
summary: High-craft launch aesthetic: floating stacked dark-mode cards with 3D perspective tilt, glossy edge glow, and spring physics push transitions.

forbidden: bounce, elastic or back overshoot on any entrance (R1)
cluttered low-contrast text over glossy background elements
more than two simultaneous animated visual focal points

frame_checklist: Foreground card perspective tilt remains under 15 degrees for legibility
Card entrance glide arrives smoothly before caption reveal initiates
Strict compliance with safezone bottom padding (>= 460px) and side bounds
Subtle specular highlight sweeps across card surface on take landing
source_techniques: AbubakrChan/product-launch-motion: perspective card layering and rim light
licence_notes: Original CSS 3D transforms and SVG gradients; no commercial sample media.
